defect_a.name: {{H1_TITLE}} template-token leakage
defect_a.cause: Token-matching regex /\{\{([A-Z_]+)\}\}/g excludes digits, so {{H1_TITLE}} never matches and is never substituted, regardless of the caller supplying a correct value.

defect_b.name: Literal "undefined" string in formula JSON-LD
defect_b.cause: Referenced a nonexistent data field (formula.description) instead of the real field (formula.metaDescription); undefined was stringified into production output by the pre-fix fill() implementation, and a downstream normalization stage then backfilled a garbled scraped meta description.

implementation_changes: scripts/template-utils.js: fill() regex fixed to [A-Z0-9_]+; added a hard throw when a token key is present but its value is null/undefined
scripts/validate-generated-output.js: new build-time validator scanning all production HTML for unresolved template artifacts

scripts/run-all-generators.js: validator wired in after normalize-seo-metadata.js and before dataset/entity/trust validation, QA, broken-link check, search index, sitemap generation, and certification
npm run build: full pipeline re-run to regenerate all production HTML from corrected generators

remaining_p0_findings.reason: Pre-existing duplicate-calculator-URL cannibalization finding from Phase 7A; unrelated to template-token leakage; explicitly out of scope for Phase 7B ("DO NOT consolidate URLs").

validator.pipeline_insertion_point: scripts/run-all-generators.js, immediately after normalize-seo-metadata.js and before validate-datasets.js

unexpected_changes.description: reports/phase-7a/index.html (this audit's own dashboard) was newly included in sitemap-other.xml and sitemap.xml by the pre-existing sitemap generator, which has no exclusion list for reports/, audit/, or qa/ directories.
unexpected_changes.root_cause: Pre-existing generate-sitemaps.js behavior (already flagged as Phase 7A finding INTERNAL_TOOLING_PAGE_IS_INDEXABLE), triggered by this audit's own output living in a swept directory.
unexpected_changes.reason_not_remediated: Fixing it requires changing sitemap generation logic, which is explicitly out of scope for Phase 7B.

unexpected_changes.description: Cosmetic 1-2 line whitespace-only diffs (footer indentation) across ~230 pages outside the three affected families.
unexpected_changes.root_cause: Pre-existing non-determinism in inject-footer.js, unrelated to the template-token fix, triggered simply by running the full build.
unexpected_changes.reason_not_remediated: Cosmetic only, no content/link/schema impact; out of scope.

unexpected_changes.description: last-updated meta tags and data/indexing/freshness.json refreshed to the current regeneration date sitewide.
unexpected_changes.reason_not_remediated: Expected behavior of running npm run build, not introduced by this phase.
